snp4.4:1.1: Suddhaṭṭhakasutta. ‘Passāmi suddhaṃ paramaṃ {arogaṃ}, diṭṭhena saṃsuddhi narassa hoti' etābhijānaṃ ‘paraman' ti ñatvā suddhānupassī ti pacceti ñāṇaṃ. || ||
snp4.4:2.1: Diṭṭhena ce suddhi narassa hoti, ñāṇena vā so pajahāti dukkhaṃ, aññena so sujjhati sopadhīko, diṭṭhī hi naṃ pāva tathā vadānaṃ. || ||
snp4.4:3.1: Na brāhmaṇo aññato suddhim āha diṭṭhe sute sīlavate mute vā, puññe ca pāpe ca anūpalitto attañjaho na-y-idha pakubbamāno. || ||
snp4.4:4.1: Purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse ejānugā *te na* taranti saṅgaṃ, te uggahāyanti nirassajanti kapīva sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāya. || || Sayaṃ
snp4.4:5.1: samādāya vatāni jantu uccāvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto, vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ na uccāvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño. || ||
snp4.4:6.1: Sa sabbadhammesu visenibhūto yaṃ kiñci diṭṭhaṃ va sutaṃ mutaṃ vā, tam evadassiṃ vivaṭaṃ carantaṃ kenīdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya. || ||
snp4.4:7.1: Na kappayanti, na purekkharonti, "accantasuddhī" ti na te vadanti,| ādānaganthaṃ gathitaṃ visajja āsaṃ na kubbanti kuhiñci loke. || ||
snp4.4:8.1: Sīmātigo brāhmaṇo, tassa n' atthi ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tassīdha n' atthī param uggahītan ti || || SUDDHAṬṬHAKASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
